name: Kagami Toshiki
source:
Hobbies: Has a wide variety of hobbies, especially when it comes to anime, games, manga, novels, social games and so on
Likes: Heart touching stories, talking about his favorite works, carbonated drinks, [url=/c98082]Tsukimi Kirina[/url] (just a fan)
Dislikes: Black tea, sweets, people who trash his favorite works

The protagonist who is part of the novelist department at Saika Private Academy. He has a cautious personality, but when he decides on something, he'll get to it instantly.

For some reason, he is currently in a slump and unable to write anything.

[Based on the [url=http://ainolinks.com/]official website[/url]]
